csv_project_name: A/E Services for Willamette Cove Nature Park
csv_scope_of_work: Consultant team will prepare design and construction documents, specifications, cost estimates, and support Metro with permitting by providing permit level drawings, reports, quantities, and technical information. The consultant will also support Metro s Construction Manager/General Contractor (CM/GC) procurement and public engagement. The park design should be cognizant of operational requirements and efficiency while considering low impact development and sustainability in the long term. Park amenities include entry and parking lot, restroom facilities, shelter, gathering spaces, regional trail segment, site-based nature trails, viewpoints, water access, wayfinding, and habitat enhancements. Consultant will also support the integration of public art and interpretation delivered under a separate contract. Metro will take the project lead in archeology, public art and interpretation contracting and selection, and local, state, and federal permitting.
csv_disciplines_requested: Design Build/Developer, Landscape Architecture, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Planning/Master Planning, Stormwater, Graphic Design/Public Art
